title: KCSAT-ML: Probing Reasoning Models with Nationwide-Cohort Human Difficulty

model.params_source: paper Appendix Table 8 row 'GPT-5 (High)' (reasoning effort high, w. TTS prompt); GPT-5 ignores temperature; max_completion_tokens assumed (average output 6,442 tokens)

task.subset_rule: paper-defined split: the 339-item core set with official cohort error rates (short-answer reformulation)
task.approximation: Problem images are re-generated locally from the official KICE PDFs with the released generator; judge parameters (effort) are not stated.

items.source: https://github.com/naver-ai/KCSAT-ML (generator downloads kcsat-ml-meta.zip and the exam-PDF URL list from Google Drive ids in src/utils/config.py, then builds data/dataset.csv and data/images/*.png)
items.config_or_split: core set (339 items with error rates)
items.license: AGPL-3.0 (repository); exam items are public KICE releases
items.filter_prose: item has an official cohort error rate
items.access_note: data/dataset.csv does not exist in the repository (404 on main); it is produced by the generator from kcsat-ml-meta.zip and the KICE exam PDFs (Google Drive ids in src/utils/config.py, present) - no direct file URL for the runner

prompt.user_template: {image}Please solve the problem given in the image.

placeholders.image: attach data/images/<id>.png as an image content part (NOT expressible)

prompt.source_location: Appendix Figure 13 'Prompt templates used in experiments', block 'VLM (w. TTS)'

output.parse_prose: free text: the model's full response is passed to the equivalence judge together with the reference answer

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: Score = share of the 339 core items whose predicted final answer the judge marks 'Correct' (narrow equivalence check against the reference, Sec. 3.2).
metric.judge: llm:gpt-5-2025-08-07, prompt location Figure 13 block 'Evaluation': "Evaluate whether the predicted answer ('{PRED_TEXT}') matches the correct answer ('{ANSWER_TEXT}'). Respond only with 'Correct' or 'Incorrect'."
metric.original_location: Appendix Table 8, row GPT-5 (High), column Score

open_points: Image inputs: the problem images must be attached (VLM setting); text-only messages cannot reproduce it. The dataset also has to be generated locally (Google Drive downloads + PDF cropping with the released generator). The gpt-5 equivalence judge (Figure 13 'Evaluation' prompt) would be a normal judge stage once the images exist.
notes: est_calls = 339 subject calls + 339 judge calls. Whether Table 8's closed-source rows used the VLM (image) or LLM (OCR) setting is not restated; the VLM setting is used (GPT-5 accepts images; README says VLMs are first-class subjects). Column names of data/dataset.csv must be checked after running the generator. || [hooks_2 2026-09-07] reviewed for a per-paper hook: image inputs; no hook written.
